svg.title: Evolution — concept sheet 01: the cell
svg.desc: Dark-field microscopy cell language: anatomy, size tiers, membrane states, trait variants, player palettes. Code-drawn SVG, no raster content. See docs/concept-art/README.md for the palette constants.
svg.text: Dark-field microscopy language · light comes from top-left, rim scatter all around · 1 world unit (wu) = 1 px at zoom 1.0
all shapes code-drawn: gradients, blur, turbulence · zero raster
level-5 cell, r = 32 wu, drawn at 4 px / wu · layer stack back → front
same cell at 2 px / wu · radius grows with √mass · organelle count grows with level
nucleus r = 30% · membrane 5% · halo +28% · organelle size ∝ r
L1: 2 lipids · L5: +2 mito, 1 vacuole · L10: +4 mito, 1 vacuole
back → front, every cell, every size
two fractalNoise passes, clipped to body
mito / vacuole / lipid symbols, size ∝ r
soft body, r = 30 wu at 2 px / wu · the nucleus lags motion, organelles slosh
six avatar hues, each a base / rim / nucleus ramp · all read on the dark field, none share a hue neighbour
v1 catalog silhouettes on the level-5 body (r = 28 wu at 2 px / wu) · each must read at 10 px on screen from outline alone
